subject: Greenfield trial: decision matrix, timelines, and owner assignments
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Sylvia Chen <sylvia@greenfield.ai>, Tom Reynolds <tom.procurement@greenfield.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Jul 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Greenfield trial: decision matrix, timelines, and owner assignments

Sylvia / Tom — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap + proposed steps so we all have a single source of truth. Please flag anything I missed.

Call summary (what we heard)
- Goal: Evaluate Redwood inference runtime for Greenfield’s real-time analytics pipeline (latency target < 120ms p50 for 1k qps scenario).
- Scope: Small-scale trial (2-week controlled run) using a representative subset of models (~2 endpoints).
- Constraints: Greenfield requires SOC2 summary and a procurement-friendly SOW; security team will run checklist.

Proposed success criteria (trial):
1) Avg inference latency p50 < 120ms and p95 < 300ms with nightly loads simulating 1k qps.
2) No functional regressions vs baseline prompts (provided by Greenfield) — test harness pass rate >= 95%.
3) Integration checklist completed (KV cache/config, auth via API keys, region placement).
4) Clear owner signoff for infra, app integration, security, procurement.

High-level timeline (suggested)
- Day 0 (next business day): Kickoff + S3 of sample prompts and traffic profile.
- Days 1–3: Infra setup (dedicated trial pool), baseline smoke tests.
- Days 4–10: Load tests + evaluation runs, iteration on prompt tuning/config.
- Day 11–12: Security checklist and logs review; procurement review DocuSign SOW.
- Day 13–14: Final results + signoff decision.

Ownership / RACI (first pass — please confirm):
- Infra (provisioning, GPU pool, config): Monica Patel (Redwood) = Responsible; Greenfield infra lead (Sylvia) = Consulted.
- App integration (client SDK, request routing, telemetry hooks): Karthik Iyer (Redwood SE) = Responsible; Sylvia = Accountable.
- Security & compliance (SOC2 docs, audit logs, retention): Marissa Cole (Redwood CSM) = Responsible for gathering docs; Mike Lang (Greenfield) = Accountable on their side.
- Procurement & contract: Alex Martinez (Redwood AE) = Responsible for SOW/terms; Tom Reynolds = Accountable.

Attachments I’m sharing: redwood-trial-plan.xlsx (detailed tasks + timeline), soc2-summary.pdf.

Immediate asks / next steps
- Sylvia: please confirm the Greenfield trial owner for the app side (who will be the daily contact for integration bugs).
- Tom: if procurement needs additional clauses, share redlines this week; I’ll attach SOW draft now.
- Monica / Karthik / Marissa: confirm you can be assigned to the roles above and call out any conflicts.

I’ll loop in the SOW and security questions in a follow-up email.

Thanks — Alex
-- 
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: Greenfield trial: decision matrix, timelines, and owner assignments

Thanks Alex — this is very helpful. Quick responses inline: 

- Greenfield app owner (daily contact): That’ll be me for the first week; I’ll hand off to our Platform lead (Jared Park) once infra is stable.
- Security: Mike from our team will run the questionnaire; I’ve attached the security-questions.xlsx our team typically fills out. Could you add any Redwood-specific entries we should expect?
- Timeline: The week-of Jul 12 works better for us to start infra provisioning (we have an internal change freeze this week). Can we push kickoff to Monday 7/12?

Also, procurement flagged that they need the SOW and a sample DPA before we sign — Tom, can you confirm if the SOW you send includes the DPA as an attachment or if we should expect a separate link?

Sylvia
